verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships a documented custom URI protocol (obsidian://) that lets external scripts trigger actions like opening or creating notes, directly matching the story's deep-link requirement, and the plugin API (Vault interface) further enables programmatic file/note manipulation. missing for 10: no evidence of a first-party local HTTP/REST endpoint (only community plugins reportedly fill that gap), and no independent hands-on validation of the URI scheme's reliability in scripted workflows.
